subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Target Breach via HVAC
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Target Breach via HVAC usable.

hook.text: Hackers stole 40 million credit card numbers from Target. Their entry point? The HVAC contractor.

buildup.text: The HVAC company had remote access to Target's network for billing. Hackers stole those credentials first.

discovery.text: Once inside, attackers installed malware on point-of-sale terminals across nearly all Target stores.

twist.text: Target's security tools actually detected the intrusion and sent alerts. The team ignored them.

climax.text: The breach cost Target $292 million and its CEO and CIO both lost their jobs.

punchline.text: The alarm went off. Nobody listened. $292 million later.

quiz.question: How did hackers initially access Target's network?
options: Through credentials stolen from the HVAC contractor
Through a phishing email to the CEO
